notes.title: Crafting, Story, Battle - big changes are coming to Abelon!
notes.notes:
[h3]Heroes of Abelon! We are very excited about our update today. Introducing the beginning of our new crafting system and our new battle system.
Our hero can now own a house, collect herbs, craft potions, and items. Dozens of new quests, puzzles, monsters, and new features await you![/h3]

[b]Version 0.8.02 is out and boy do we have news for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero can now own a house!
[*] Introducing a new crafting system which includes (to be upgraded in future versions - suggestions and ideas are welcomed)
[*] Potion table
[*] Anvil
[*] Furnace
[*] Brand new puzzles!
[*] Reworked mission log window with new indications
[*] Dozens of new missions
[*] Improved battle system
[*] 8 new herbs! You can now collect herbs all over Abelon (even in the depth of Digsome mines)
[*] Multiple new enemies/mobs to fight
[*] Zombie immunity mechanic has changed and is now temporary (but worry not, you can still refill it)
[*] Iron mining is now available
[*] A new town was implemented
[*] A new memory area is now accessible - many more updates to that area are planned.
[*] The magical world map has been upgraded to reflect locations of herbs
[*] Boat visual improvements
[*] You can now decorate your home (more in the next updates - send us your suggestion/ideas)
[*] Sleep animations have been further improved (Tent will be upgraded on the next version)
[*] Bulletin board improved
[*] Magic mini-tutorial has been further improved
[*] Digsome mines have been renovated
[*] Prices at stores are now auto-adjusted based on your karma
[*] Added hammer tool and animations for crafting
[*] Added shovel animation and sand digging (as well as sand areas to dig from)
[*] Multiple graphics updates
[*] Inventory screen upgraded for easier use
[*] Puzzle re-balance
[/list]

[i]Yes, we know we may have a few bugs left and we are working hard to iron them out.
However, we would really appreciate your help if you can continue and send any bug/thought/suggestions you may have to wizards@overall.games or write at the community discussion boards.[/i]

notes.title: Update v0.8.01 is now ready!
notes.notes:
Heroes!

The world of Abelon is changing, new items, monsters, quality of life and more…
read all about it and embrace yourself for more updates in the coming weeks with more puzzles and missions coming your way.

Version 0.8.01 is out and here are our release notes:
Updated / fixed light settings
Updated / fixed dialogs
Updated mission list directions to be more clear
Updated some monsters / NPCs with AI
Added new events
Added hidden treasure counter viewable via the status page
Fix bug when traveling to Jungle area
Updated job post tasks / interaction
Added explanations to mini-games
Updated color set in some mini-games
Changed reward system
Store names adjusted
Changed hat to Viking Helmet with different stats
Improved access to some areas
Updated some of the sprites
Changed raise dead mechanics
Added tutorial for killing the undead
Updated some dialogs to improve the storytelling
Added animation/effects of Lava/Acid/Poison
Added animation to mining
Sleeping in a bed is now showing the hero lying inside the bed
Updated map with new towns/portals to be accessed in later versions
Introduced new monsters
Updated soundtrack / sound effects
Added sliders for volume control
Cheese and drumstick will now be auto consumed
Introduced cure poison potion
Added poisoned state to HUD
Cheese / Drumstick can now be purchased at the coffee shop
All potions can be purchased at the wizard’s home
Added option to exit the tower of death without completing the puzzle after losing to a Minotaur
General bug fixes

Yours truly,
The wizards of Abelon

notes.title: Quality of life changes
notes.notes:
Hi All,

While we are working on adding new quests and puzzles…

We’re pushing some quality of life changes so you can already enjoy some changes made by your feedback.

Quality of life changes:
Visual improvement to mouse click indicator
A smoother passage between locations
Minimap now has points of interest indicators
Introduced a new magical mining area
Some of the town jobs have been balanced
Some of the monster difficulty has been balanced
Introduced new experience points indicator bar
New mining animations (currently applied only to new mining area)
Multiple minor bugs fixed
